items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Nazzaro introduced us to Gene Buck and Florence Ziegfeld

ctx.x: So we go to the Follies to get this job and do the audition. I know all this about the Follies now, kind of show it is, the biggest show in the world and everything, but Buck, he doesn't know about bigness, he just knows he plays the piano and what time the show starts and what time it's over, that's all. So we go do the shows and we go to the audition and Nazarro introduced us to Gene Buck and Florence Ziegfeld and there's a baby grand piano over there, Buck goes over to the piano and starts noodling around on…

the first song in about this tempo "Bap-Bop-Beep-Beep-Beep-Bup-Beep -- about that tempo, I'll let you know what it is, okay?" Allright. Wait a couple of minutes. I pick my chance to catch them when they weren't talking. And I jumped onto this song -- I go, "Bang, hit it." He hits it and I did this song and "Wang" and they were surprised -- Nazarro and Ziegfeld and Gene Buck were surprised when we hit this number like we did and go through that song and get it over with and they didn't get a chance to say do such…
afford to pay you boys $500 a week and I'm asking for seven -- no, $750." He's asking for $750, he is. Ziggie can only pay $500. Okay.
